results.title: Chelsea in talks for Villa set-piece guru MacPhee
results.description: Chelsea are in talks to sign highly regarded set-piece coach Austin MacPhee from Aston Villa but face competition from other Premier League clubs as well as Saudi Pro League teams. Villa would be due compensation for MacPhee with his contract understood to have a specified release clause. The Scottish coach, 46, has combined his role at Villa Park [...]

results.title: Zimbabwe's biggest T20I defeats against India
results.description: Zimbabwe suffered a 90-run defeat to India in the 2nd T20I at Harare Sports Club. Chasing 220, the hosts perished for 129 in 17.5 overs.

results.title: Josh Cook ‘really pleased’ with perfect BTCC Saturday at Thruxton
results.description: Josh Cook's Thruxton magic shone once more in the British Touring Car Championship's Race to Pole, which he hopes will 'convert' to Sunday joy. The post Josh Cook ‘really pleased’ with perfect BTCC Saturday at Thruxton appeared first on Motorsport Week .

results.title: NRL prodigal son Lomax signs with PNG Chiefs
results.description: NRL prodigal son Zac Lomax has locked in a whirlwind rugby league return, becoming the latest big name to join expansion side Papua New Guinea for their 2028 debut.

results.title: San Diego FC Defeats FC Dallas 1-0 in Major League Soccer
results.description: Alejandro Alvarado scores his first career Major League Soccer goal as San Diego FC defeats FC Dallas 1-0 in a crucial win for the team.
